findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "account" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_businesses, list_clients, get_client_statement, create_draft_expense, send_reminder · Private data: list_invoices, get_invoice, list_quotes, get_quote, get_vat_summary, get_dashboard_summary, get_whats_due, get_vat_return_boxes, calculate_vat, check_einvoicing_readiness, check_vat_on_supply, create_draft_expense, send_reminder, record_payment · Public sink: list_businesses, list_clients, create_draft_invoice, send_reminder, prepare_invoice · Destructive: check_trn, check_einvoicing_readiness.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_businesses, list_clients, get_client_statement, create_draft_expense, send_reminder · Private data: list_invoices, get_invoice, list_quotes, get_quote, get_vat_summary, get_dashboard_summary, get_whats_due, get_vat_return_boxes, calculate_vat, check_einvoicing_readiness, check_vat_on_supply, create_draft_expense, send_reminder, record_payment · Public sink: list_businesses, list_clients, create_draft_invoice, send_reminder, prepare_invoice · Destructive: check_trn, check_einvoicing_readiness

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
